mathematics.assertion_tested: Four spherical mixed TF profiles and six fixed-species-mass GP/baryon BVPs satisfy the explicitly coded mass, ODE, boundary, virial and two-box comparisons; the pure scalar TF profile agrees with sin(x)/x.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE float64 numerical approximation via NumPy/SciPy
mathematics.conventions: Poisson laplacian U=rho_d+rho_b. Full GP and the eta=1 TF seed use K=.5,Kb=.4,h_d=2K rho_d,h_b=(5/2)Kb rho_b^(2/3). Other TF eta values test equation (13) as independent dimensionless ODE parameters, equivalently varying Kb at fixed h_c=1; eta=0 is the pure scalar limit. Radial masses omit common 4pi.
inputs: coupled spherical hydrostatic and GP/Poisson equations documented in EQUILIBRIUM.md
non_claims: No certified continuum eigenvalue or global minimum
No uniqueness, formation, Lyapunov orbital stability, dipole population or universal normalization
No full relativistic or source-channel state
